title: LLMTrace.v1
description: One single-model LLM invocation captured for the determinism ledger. An LLMTrace is RAW PROPOSAL evidence: it records what one model returned for one prompt, with model/provider identity and a prompt_hash handle, but it is NEVER truth on its own. It carries its own schema/grounding/deterministic validation results so the miner can tell a validated, grounded proposal from an ungrounded one — but only a WorkflowTrace with verified=true (adjudicated/source-grounded/receipt-backed) is mineable. The raw prompt/response bytes are NOT inlined here (they live in the object store / private tenant store, referenced by prompt_hash + response_ref); no secrets, no PII. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

source_scope.description: tenant_private LLM output can never train a global rule unless anonymized + approved

model_id.description: the model that produced this proposal

provider_id.description: routed via the single LLMGateway; a direct-provider bypass is a contract violation

prompt_hash.description: hash handle for the prompt; the raw prompt is NOT inlined (private prompts → object/tenant store)

response_ref.description: opaque content-addressed ref (objref:sha256:...) to the stored raw response; never inlined here

grounding_validation.description: did this proposal cite real source handles, or is it ungrounded (allegation/summary)

deterministic_validation.description: did Baltor's deterministic authority agree with this proposal (evidence the proposal is safe to mine toward)

proposed_decision.description: the model's proposed output — a PROPOSAL, never the served truth on its own

is_truth.description: structurally pinned false: a single LLM proposal is NEVER truth (truth comes from a validator/adjudication)

source_handles.description: handles the proposal cited; an ungrounded proposal carries an empty list and is not mineable

latency_ms.description: optional observability field; not used for truth
